dispositions.field: RUN_STATUSES / harness STATUS_* and TERMINAL_* / run.json
dispositions.reason: Run bundles are terminal snapshots, including GAP contamination/provider/budget reclassification; terminal markers are harness observations, independently inventoried.

Durable membership and resumable attempts; status snapshots reference searchlight.run. Cancelled GAP cells and deferred cells may be retried. No mandatory resume actor or retention sweeper; enforcement=missing. Proposed owner audit within 180s.
Provider result and normalized call records are mapped separately. Retrieval/agent cells project results; async pending/completed IDs belong to external providers, not a Searchlight job engine.

dispositions.field: EVALUATION_OUTCOMES; gap/brief_grade.py status; agreement measured/not_measured; verify JUnit statuses
dispositions.reason: Immutable outcome/brief result snapshots are mapped. Agreement, source coverage, benchmark/report/index aggregates and capture statuses are derived observations; missing judgment is never success.

dispositions.field: schema config enums; catalog/model profiles; token accounting; provider availability; live auth/egress/containment probes
dispositions.reason: Configuration and diagnostics are not extra durable status lifecycles. Pure hash/parser/render helpers own no state machine. Existing live/host probes remain explicitly manual; fixture smoke cannot certify paid execution or platform containment.

deadEndNotes: Proposed lifetime/expiry bounds above are not repairs. See each state deadEndEvidence selector.
ownershipNotes: Snapshots/observations do not transfer ownership from the referenced runtime. Synthetic smoke evidence does not prove live dispatch or provider behavior.
